# Koterie Language Studio

Koterie is an online English-learning experience that combines live classes with continued practice, community activities and digital tools between classes.

## Public pages
- Home: https://mi-web-online.vercel.app/
- Seminars: https://mi-web-online.vercel.app/seminars
- Classes and pricing: https://mi-web-online.vercel.app/pricing

## Main offering
- Live online English classes, both group and individual.
- Academy for learners consolidating their English.
- Studio for more advanced conversation and fluency.
- Activities, speaking practice and community between lessons.
- Special English-language seminars.

## Access
Student dashboards, profiles, forums, practice areas and administration pages are private and require authentication. They should not be indexed or treated as public documentation.

## Language
The public website is primarily in Spanish. Learning activities and seminars may be in English.
